paragraphs.text: Ulaten was one of Shanna 's crew on the Skyship Weatherlight prior to its Compleation .

Ulaten was a member of the Weatherlight 's cockpit crew, known for their ability to lighten stressful situations with humor. During the Phyrexian attack on the Weatherlight, Ulaten was among those who were severely injured. When Shanna and Tiana later ventured into the corrupted Weatherlight, they found Ulaten’s head incorporated into a Phyrexian tentacle-like appendage. This horrifying transformation was the result of the Phyrexian corruption that had overrun the ship. Shanna confronted this abomination and severed Ulaten’s tentacle, ending his suffering and releasing his spirit from the torment.
